prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Onboarding Pet Care Quick Start Screen: Adds a dedicated quick start guide screen at the end of onboarding that explains essential pet interaction, hiding, and controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_quick_start"]}, "new_pet_quick_start": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, chat with, feed, or temporarily hide your desktop pet from the system controls.", "layout": "list"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Carousel Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection step into an immersive full-bleed hero carousel showcasing each pet's visual style and personality.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "large"}]}}}
2: [choose_path, reorder] Reorder Story Screen After Path Choice: Reorders onboarding so users select their path immediately upon launch before viewing the narrative background story.
   config: {"choose_path": {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Generation Fallback Assistant Flow: Adds an interactive fallback tip carousel during photo upload offering preset templates if custom pet generation fails or looks wrong.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "subtle", "text": "Generation issue? Switch to preset companion templates anytime to continue without delay."}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Verification Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in restores all existing pets and progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account to instantly restore your previously adopted desktop pets and inventory."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Readiness Progress Details: Displays active progress indicators and loading stage status text while waiting for the mascot to render on the desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Initializing desktop graphics render engine and mascot traits..."}}
6: [home, notification] Background Hatching Notification Status Alert: Shows a system notification readiness badge on the waiting screen letting users know they can safely minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Desktop readiness alert enabled. Feel free to minimize this window while your pet hatches.", "style": "rounded"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Screen Layout: Changes the adoption certificate screen to a side-by-side split layout showcasing a live companion preview alongside official pet details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clear Outcome Headline: Updates the choose_path headline and body to explicitly differentiate adopting a ready-made pet versus creating a custom pet.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Path: Pick a Companion or Build a Custom Pet", "body": "Select whether you want to choose from pre-made pet friends or upload photos to generate a custom desktop pet."}}
9: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Desktop Mascot Interaction Badge: Adds an animated highlight badge on the home intro screen directing users to immediate system tray desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful", "text": "Your desktop pet is now active! Right-click the system tray icon anytime to open controls or chat."}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid post-onboarding quick start screen after home_intro.
Redesigns pet selection layout while preserving pet choice functionality.
Reordering onboarding steps is explicitly permitted.
Adds a valid fallback tip component to the photo upload screen.
Adds a helpful informational hint to the sign-in screen.
Updates waiting screen progress details within allowed onboarding changes.
Adds a valid readiness notification badge to the waiting screen.
Replacing the certificate with a preview element loses the official adoption stamp.
Clarifies choose path copy while retaining both adoption options.
Adds a valid feature highlight badge to the home intro screen.
